title: Meet the energy savings target under the Energy Savings Scheme
what: As an electricity retailer or other scheme participant, meet the yearly energy savings target by surrendering energy savings certificates, or pay the shortfall penalty.

sources.title: Electricity Supply Act 1995 (NSW)
